title: research-ledger — timestamped record of the commit history of HistorEE_codebooks and myfoamrepo
description:
One hash-chained entry for every pushed branch head of two public research repositories, HistorEE_codebooks and myfoamrepo, each with an OpenTimestamps proof tying it to a Bitcoin block. The ledger dates the pushed history of both repositories independently of GitHub and of the author.

A deposit is a snapshot of the ledger at the release. The live ledger is the GitHub repository.
